numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyFloor.jsonsch.description:
AutonomyFloor caps the level of the changes it matches; when floors from the org and control packs match, the
 lowest max_level holds.

match.description: match is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

max_level.description: max_level is required: no rule, default or narrower scope resolves a matching change above it.
max_level.title: Autonomy Level

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyFloor.jsonsch.title: Autonomy Floor

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyFloors.jsonsc.description: AutonomyFloors is the set of floors; it is one message so the whole set carries the FORBID directive.

rules.description: rules is required and non-empty; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyFloors.jsonsc.title: Autonomy Floors

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyMatch.jsonsch.description:
AutonomyMatch selects changes; an absent key matches every value and an empty match matches every change. In a
 rule, risk matches exactly and a key the change has no value for does not match. In a floor, risk matches that
 class and every higher one, and a key the change has no value for counts as a match.

environment.description: environment is the name of the environment the change acts in.

playbook.description: playbook is the name of the change's playbook.

risk.description: risk is the change's risk class, fixed at Classified.
risk.title: Risk Class

numinance.kinds.v1.AutonomyMatch.jsonsch.title: Autonomy Match

numinance.kinds.v1.ControlFloors.jsonsch.description: ControlFloors is the set of floors a pack adds; it is one message so the whole set carries the FORBID directive.

autonomy.description: autonomy caps levels as AutonomyPolicy floors do; the lowest matching max_level of the org and every pack holds.

residency.description: residency adds residency floors as ResidencyPolicy floors do; every floor of the org and every pack holds.

numinance.kinds.v1.ControlFloors.jsonsch.title: Control Floors

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyFloors.jsons.description: ResidencyFloors is the set of floors; it is one message so the whole set carries the FORBID directive.

floor.description: floor is required: it applies to every change, together with every matching rule's floor.
floor.title: Residency Class

rules.description: rules add floors per component and environment; a rule never relaxes floor.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyFloors.jsons.title: Residency Floors

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyMatch.jsonsc.description:
ResidencyMatch selects changes; an absent key matches every value and an empty match matches every change, and a
 key the change has no value for counts as a match. Floors from the org and control packs all hold together.

component.description:
component is the name of the component the change touches. It is not a security boundary until floors match only
 components of an org-owned SIGNED_POLICY registry, since a repo can rename one.

environment.description: environment is the name of the environment the change acts in.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyMatch.jsonsc.title: Residency Match

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyRule.jsonsch.description: ResidencyRule adds a floor for the changes it matches.

match.description: match is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.ResidencyRule.jsonsch.title: Residency Rule
